summary: Elixire is a self-hosted Python application designed to handle screenshot uploads and link shortening. It provides a centralised endpoint to capture and share visual or text assets quickly.
goodFor: It suits individuals looking for a lightweight, self-hosted utility to manage their own media uploads and shortened URLs without relying on third-party services.
watchOut: The lack of recent commits and official releases suggests the project may be unmaintained, meaning you could encounter unresolved bugs or security vulnerabilities.
deployNotes: As a Python application, you will typically need to run it behind a WSGI server and a reverse proxy like Nginx to handle TLS termination and static file serving, alongside persistent storage for uploaded files.
